description: This file defines a 'project' repository for database operations related to project differentials, including inserting diff rows and retrieving the most recent differential data, using SQL queries and external mappers.

classes.name: project
classes.description: Repository struct for project differential database operations, including database connection, target info, and timestamp generator.

methods.name: InsertDiffRows
methods.description: Inserts multiple differential rows into the project_differential table within a transaction.

methods.name: GetMostRecentOuterKey
methods.description: Retrieves the latest timestamp and UUID for a given upstream and downstream target pair.

methods.name: GetMostRecentDifferentials
methods.description: Fetches the most recent differential rows based on the latest timestamp and UUID.

methods.name: NewProjectRepository
methods.description: Factory function to create a new project repository instance with database connection and target info.
